question: Owning a €300,000 flat costs 1% a year in property tax, 1% upkeep and 3% in lost investment returns. Matching monthly rent, in euros?
move: Compare the money you never get back on each side, not rent with nothing.
ask: When I say renting is throwing money away, have I counted what owning throws away too?
trap: Treating rent as money lost and owning as if it cost nothing.
hint: Add up what owning costs each year that is never got back.
reference: Unrecoverable costs of owning versus renting, worked arithmetic, 2026
